name: Cefpodoxime
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 100 mg every 12 hours for 5 to 10 days
400 mg every 12 hours for 7 to 14 days

key_interactions.action: Separate from antacids; avoid H2 blockers if possible.

key_interactions.effect: Nephrotoxicity not seen alone, but monitor (label).

contraindications: Known allergy to cefpodoxime or other cephalosporins

pk.half_life: About 3.3 hours (4.2 hours in older adults)
pk.half_life_eskd: 5.9 hours at CrCl 30–49; 9.8 hours at CrCl 5–29 (label)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 29% to 33% unchanged in urine in 12 hours
